🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Moderate concentration (Top 5 span 3 sectors — Technology, Consumer Staples, Consumer Discretionary); confirmations: cyclicals showing leadership (F, CAT, FCX 1W strength) and Growth and Value both participating (NVDA/AMD tech strength alongside XOM/CVX energy).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leading: CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +21.21% | 1M: +45.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.46% | 1M: +18.54%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing strength: XOM (1W: +4.23% | 1M: +2.53%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: MNST (1W: +12.97% | 1M: +14.53%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +12.13% | 1M: +22.06%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -12.91%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -11.57% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND. Communication under pressure: CHTR (1W: -7.64% | 1M: -32.82%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG (1W: -9.81% | 1M: -16.81%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -10.20%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +21.21% | 1M: +45.15%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +20.38% | 1M: +15.36%) ABOVE TREND, MNST (1W: +12.97% | 1M: +14.53%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +12.13% | 1M: +22.06%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate concentration (3 sectors in Top 5), signaling selective but meaningful momentum.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: DHR (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -16.96%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -3.13%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -7.64% | 1M: -32.82%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -12.91%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select large-cap software/communications and utilities.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W movers: CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +21.21% | 1M: +45.15%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +20.38% | 1M: +15.36%) ABOVE TREND, MNST (1W: +12.97% | 1M: +14.53%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +12.13% | 1M: +22.06%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence across large caps (META RECOVERY, AMZN CORRECTION, JNJ RECOVERY) — treat as tactical dispersion despite RISK-ON.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive: NVDA (1W: +11.46% | 1M: +18.54%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +74.22%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND; offset by INTU (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -3.13%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology: 12/24 positive (internal rotation, selective leadership).

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed/soft overall: V (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND but JPM (1W: -2.08% | 1M: -1.97%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -5.77%) BELOW TREND, though pockets (WFC, SCHW headlines) show pockets of strength. Sector breadth: Financials: 6/20 positive (internal rotation, watch credit-sensitive names).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Patchy with select leaders: UNH (1W: +7.94% | 1M: +27.08%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.26% | 1M: +11.23%) ABOVE TREND, but DHR (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -16.96%) BELOW TREND and PFE (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -3.73%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 9/17 positive (internal rotation, defensive names mixed).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to tech leaders and cyclicals showing strength (NVDA (1W: +11.46% | 1M: +18.54%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +74.22%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +20.38% | 1M: +15.36%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap software laggards and weak utilities. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt, but remain cautious on concentration and the noted large-cap divergences.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +11.46% | 1M: +18.54%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through; CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/news confirmed move; AMZN (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +7.53%) CORRECTION — watch if AI narrative resumes. BEARISH: CRM (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -9.81% | 1M: -16.81%) BELOW TREND — downside momentum, monitor guidance/earnings; HD (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -10.20%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (Tech: 12/24 positive) — leadership narrow but powerful; Energy (Energy: 8/10 positive) — steady macro support. BEARISH: Financials (Financials: 6/20 positive) — mixed; Utilities (Utilities: 2/10 positive) — continued pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +11.46% | 1M: +18.54%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for weekly follow-through above recent breakout; AAPL (1W: +3.84% | 1M: +12.03%) ABOVE TREND — watch hold of 1M trend support; JPM (1W: -2.08% | 1M: -1.97%) BELOW TREND — a reclaim of near-term resistance would signal Financials stabilization; CRM (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND — failure to regain 1W support warns further downside.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
CSCO (+55): Cisco surge on AI demand matches price action — CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMZN (+60): AI narrative bullish versus price in CORRECTION — AMZN (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +7.53%) CORRECTION — watch for news follow-through. BA (+60): Boeing optimism confirmed by sell-side headlines but price mixed — BA (1W: -0.79% | 1M: +2.36%) CORRECTION.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-50): Negative headlines while stock is RECOVERY — META (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -7.91%) RECOVERY; divergence warrants monitoring for distribution. GOOGL (-50): Bearish sentiment vs price strength — GOOGL (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +18.97%) ABOVE TREND; watch credit/debt headlines for risk. CRM (-45): Sentiment confirms price breakdown — CRM (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Growth/Momentum tilt. NVDA (1W: +11.46% | 1M: +18.54%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND and F (1W: +20.38% | 1M: +15.36%) ABOVE TREND are showing clear relative strength. Key risk is major large-cap divergence (META RECOVERY with negative news, GOOGL ABOVE TREND vs bearish headlines) — monitor for trend breaks or concentration risk.
